We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts. The case: Using fiddler to intercept and manipulate third-party payment platform, stealing money from fintech app. Also teaching others method. So crimes: (1) Theft (or fraud?) In Chinese criminal law, "非法占有为目的，采用秘密手段，窃取公私财物" is theft (盗窃罪). However using computer means may be "非法获取计算机信息系统数据、非法控制计算机信息系统罪" (破坏计算机信息系统罪) or "利用信息网络非法获取他人金融账户信息" maybe "诈骗"? But they are stealing money directly from platform, using software to manipulate. This is typical "盗窃罪" (theft) but also "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" (非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪) under article 285 of Criminal Law (now 285?). In examples, similar case: "持有、使用假币;盗窃" they used both. For hacking and stealing money, earlier example: "破坏计算机信息系统" for modifying game recharge data. That was "破坏计算机信息系统". Here they are using fiddler to intercept and withdraw money, which is illegal access and theft. Could be "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" (非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪) and "盗窃罪". Also "组织、领导传销活动" not relevant. "提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具" is for providing tools. Here they also taught others, which could be "帮助信息网络犯罪" maybe "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪". In Chinese law, there is "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" (Article 293). The act of providing technical means to commit crimes. So charges: (1) 盗窃罪 (theft) (2) 破坏计算机信息系统罪? Actually "破坏计算机信息系统罪" is for damaging system, not just theft. "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" is for obtaining data. The theft of money from platform is akin to "非法获取计算机信息系统数据" plus "诈骗"? But the examples: For the case of "陈某" using fake money to steal cash, they gave "持有、使用假币;盗窃". For the case of "朱某某" modifying game recharge data, they gave "破坏计算机信息系统". For the case of "陈4某、黄1某" making fake website for fraud, they gave "提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具". For the case of "倪某" teaching others method, that is providing means. So likely charge: "盗窃罪" and "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪". But the description says "向他人传授犯罪方法，应当以××追究其刑事责任". That aligns with "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪". So final answer: [罪名]盗窃;帮助信息网络犯罪活动<eoa>

Check if they also include "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪". The public prosecution may charge both theft and illegal access. But examples didn't show combination of theft and illegal access. In similar case of "陈某" they had both "持有、使用假币;盗窃". So they list multiple charges separated by semicolon. So we can list "盗窃;帮助信息网络犯罪活动". That seems appropriate.

Thus final answer JSON with reasoning and final answer.
